notes.title: New Bundle Release - Jogos Brasileiros
notes.notes:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40007110/c24d9bd3f1354059a3e7bcd151183775cce90dce.png

Hello Everyone!

We would like to announce that one of titles, The Darkest Island has entered a new promotional bundle.

This Bundle, JOGOS BRASILEIROS it's possible find different games from Brazilian Inde Game developers.

In this new package the minimum promotion is 20%.
This is a good time to acquire our game in partnership with Gamix Studios.
If you already own our title and want to complete a collection of JOGOS BRASILEIROS this is your chance!

Thank you for joining us in our indie studio. If you notice something that seems to be wrong, please report it as bug!

And that's what I have for you today. See you all soon!
